Name: Shadow's Better Buildings
Author: ShadowloreDragonkin
Description:
I really don't know what to put here, first mod upload, pics will be pretty self explanatory.

This splits the greenhouse into two 6x18 garden areas as well as 12 slots for trees.  (Yes, I know, not enough to have two of EVERY type of tree, but it's symmetrical)
Also... let's be honest, that orange diamond tile was fugly... but I like the wood floor from Willy's fish shop... so I changed the floor (hence the need for those 12 tree slots and the stone border around them)

I also made a custom window texture so I could put an outdoorsy area in the back.  I love using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35690]Dynamic Windows[/url]﻿, but I also wanted to be able to have more than one greenhouse via using the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21778]Build More Greenhouses[/url]﻿ mod.  Problem is, as of the date I'm uploading this, Dynamic Windows only works on ONE greenhouse, so this was my personal fix.

I made this file for myself but decided to share because why not.  Its intended use was to make nice, even rows for use with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15239]Immersive Sprinklers[/url]﻿.  The Iridium sprinklers from that mod are able to accommodate a 6x6 square without pressure nozzles.

Uh... I guess just check it out?

Should work with any retextures.  Except for just a couple bits on a custom tileset, it just uses vanilla tiles and on my end it works just fine using the Earthy Recolor, so I'd assume it works with others.

UPDATE:
Updooted the tileset to fix a few graphics glitches/errors.  One in particular being the stone square around the tree spots... logically speaking, they weren't... well, square.  Considering it's intended to be a raised stone border, if one were to be able to look down on it from above, it would have been a rectangle, fixed the texture and updated the greenhouse map accordingly.  Also modded the shadows around eges of walls a bit to give myself something to work with in the future.

Also, added a cellar replacement now.  Sorry to say, in a world where modern technology exists, it doesn't stand to reason that the cellar that was JUST BUILT would look like crap.  I'd understand if the cellar had been on the house from the start, given the house was old... but Robin just built that cellar.  If her workmanship was that crappy, she'd have no business taking care of a whole community's needs.   So anyway, I cleaned up the cellar, made it have square corners, and changed the floors/walls around.  Added a custom wainscotting (lower paneling) to complement the now stone walls.  No garbage, no clutter, just an empty stone and wood cellar, and it's dark too!

If you wanna plaster the walls with your own lights, I'd suggest using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21233]Build Anything Anywhere[/url]﻿, though at the time of writing this, you're better off with the [url=https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/unofficial-mod-updates.2096/post-146688]Unofficial Update[/url]﻿ to that mod.

I've added a config menu through GMCM so you can individually turn these two rooms on and off.

eh.... yeah, so... I guess that's it then?

OH yeah, and since it's more than one room now, changed the name from Shadow's Better Greenhouse to just... Shadow's Better Buildings... creative, I know <3
